data.name: Howie
data.gender_notes: Howie is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Howie is derived from the Old English word hugh, which means 'heart, mind, and spirit'. In Anglo-Saxon culture, Howie signified a wise and brave individual. The name gained popularity in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages. The name Howie carries the meaning “Wise, Brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Howie usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Howie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Howie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
